item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera visits a pond near her school in Kerala and spots a frog sitting on a rock by the water. Later, she sees the same frog swimming in the pond. Her teacher asks the class to classify the frog's habitat and explain why the pond must be protected. Which statement is correct?

options.A: The frog lives in a terrestrial habitat because it was first seen sitting on a rock.
options.B: The frog is an amphibian because it lives both on land and in water, so damage to either the pond or the land around it threatens its survival.
options.C: The frog lives in an aquatic habitat because it can swim, so only the pond water needs protection.
options.D: The frog has no fixed habitat because it keeps moving between land and water.
